```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
```

## Data

```{r}
faculty_raw <- read_csv("FacultySalaries_1995.csv")
glimpse(faculty_raw)
colnames(faculty_raw)
```

## Data cleaning 
```{r}
faculty_tidy <- faculty_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(AvgAssistProfSalary, AvgAssocProfSalary, AvgFullProfSalary),
    names_to = "Rank",
    values_to = "Salary") %>%
  mutate(
    Rank = recode(Rank,
                  AvgAssistProfSalary = "Assistant",
                  AvgAssocProfSalary = "Associate",
                  AvgFullProfSalary = "Full"),
    Rank = factor(Rank, levels = c("Assistant", "Associate", "Full")),
    Tier = factor(Tier),
    State = factor(State))
  
glimpse(faculty_tidy)

faculty_tidy <- faculty_tidy %>%
  filter(!is.na(Salary))
```
## Boxplot of Faculty Salaries by Rank, Tier, and State
```{r}
ggplot(faculty_tidy, aes(x = Rank, y = Salary, fill = Tier)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~State) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Faculty Salaries by Rank, Tier, and State",
    x = "Rank",
    y = "Salary")
```
# ANOVA Model
```{r}
anova_model <- aov(Salary ~ State + Tier + Rank, data = faculty_tidy)

summary(anova_model)
```
## Juniper Oils Data
```{r}
juniper_raw <- read_csv("Juniper_Oils.csv")

glimpse(juniper_raw)
```
## TIDY JUNIPER Data
```{r}
chemicals <- c(
  "alpha-pinene","para-cymene","alpha-terpineol","cedr-9-ene",
  "alpha-cedrene","beta-cedrene","cis-thujopsene","alpha-himachalene",
  "beta-chamigrene","cuparene","compound 1","alpha-chamigrene",
  "widdrol","cedrol","beta-acorenol","alpha-acorenol",
  "gamma-eudesmol","beta-eudesmol","alpha-eudesmol",
  "cedr-8-en-13-ol","cedr-8-en-15-ol","compound 2","thujopsenal")

juniper_tidy <- juniper_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(chemicals),
    names_to = "ChemicalID",
    values_to = "Concentration")
  
ggplot(juniper_tidy, aes(x = YearsSinceBurn, y = Concentration)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ChemicalID, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw()
```

## GLM MODEL
```{r}
glm_model <- glm(Concentration ~ ChemicalID * YearsSinceBurn,
  data = juniper_tidy)
```
## Results
```{r}
glm_results <- tidy(glm_model)

significant_terms <- glm_results %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05)

significant_terms
```

Several chemical compounds show significant changes in concentration with increasing years since burn, suggesting that fire history influences the chemical composition of juniper oils.
